key_highlights: ASX shed ~$90bn in a week as rate-hike fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks (Headlines 26, 51)
Oil prices 'exploded' as OPEC+ suppression failed, driving fuel prices up 30c/L and stoking inflation concerns (Headlines 19, 40)
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase (Headlines 32, 38)
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path (Headline 49)
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices falling steeply while affordable segment remains resilient (Headlines 42, 73)
Mining sector under pressure with Canaccord-led cap raises and iron ore weakness (Headlines 27, 32)
Australia softened gas supply rules and sold gas reservation, easing Asian energy fears (Headlines 52, 63)
Chinese inflation surged, adding external risk to commodity demand outlook (Headline 59)

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; oil surge benefits energy names but broad mining selloff. Cap raises signal capital-raising stress. Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term downside on iron ore weakness. Energy names (Santos, Woodside) supported by oil surge and gas policy easing. Small-cap miners (SUN.AX, MNR.AX) offer speculative upside but elevated risk.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate-hike fears pressured bank equities. NIM compression risk if RBA holds. Superannuation policy debate adds regulatory uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX likely under pressure from yield volatility and growth scare. Monitor RBA commentary on rental inflation for rate path clarity.

sectors.trend: Positive. Oil 'exploded' on failed suppression; gas policy liberalisation supports domestic producers. Fuel price pass-through to consumers.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX), Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from oil/gas price tailwinds and policy support. Downstream refiners face margin pressure from input costs.

sectors.trend: Mixed-negative. Woolworths price increases during 'Price Freeze' erode consumer confidence. Women's clothing chain closing 177 stores signals retail weakness. Tax burden concerns rising.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs and consumer caution. Defensive positioning in staples warranted.

sectors.trend: Divergent. High-end residential prices falling steeply; affordable segment resilient. RBA rental inflation concern supports REIT valuations but caps upside. NZ housing correction in progress.
sectors.implications: High-end REITs (e.g., premium residential) face downside. Industrial and healthcare REITs more resilient. Monitor rental yield spreads.

sectors.trend: Selective positive. ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. HIVE AI cloud expansion. Battery tech (Critical Resources) in testing phase.
sectors.implications: Speculative small-cap activity elevated. AI/tech names (HIVE) show growth narrative but liquidity risk. Battery tech (CRB.AX) in long-term optionality phase.

key_themes: Oil price surge and inflation re-acceleration driving rate-hike fears
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 200 mining weight
AUD weakness on growth scare; commodity demand risk from China
Housing market bifurcation: luxury correction vs affordable resilience
Gas policy liberalisation supporting energy sector
Mining cap raises signalling capital stress in mid/small-cap resources
Consumer squeeze: fuel, food, tax burden rising simultaneously
Geopolitical risk: China 'smug' posture, Arctic shipping, inflation surge

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation re-acceleration forcing RBA to hike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy long exposure; reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse from Chinese slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weight; diversify into gold and energy
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented earnings (mining, agribusiness)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction spilling into broader economy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor credit growth and construction data; avoid overexposure to high-end property
Maintain diversified global exposure; monitor commodity supply chain disruptions

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy equities on oil surge and gas policy tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'exploded' on failed suppression; gas reservation sold and supply rules softened, supporting domestic producers

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure on cap raise catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Canaccord-led cap raises and ASX runners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) signal active deal flow; gold-silver exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offers optionality

opportunities.recommendation: Add gold exposure as hedge against inflation and AUD weakness
opportunities.rationale: Gold 'schmould' may be near-term but structural inflation and geopolitical risk support medium-term bid

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; Chinese inflation and demand risk elevate downside for BHP, RIO, FMG

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-end property and rate-sensitive REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at luxury end; RBA rental inflation concern may delay rate cuts, pressuring valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash or short-duration bonds as rate-hike risk builds
defensive_moves.rationale: Late-stage bubble warning; oil-driven inflation may force RBA hawkish pivot

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation fears and iron ore weakness persist. RBA rental inflation commentary may trigger hawkish repricing. AUD remains under pressure. Expect volatility in 10-yr bond yields.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Gas policy reform and energy transition (battery tech, renewables) offer structural tailwinds. Housing correction may create entry points in 6-12 months. Iron ore oversupply risk is the key wildcard.
